postinstall.command:
cd /tmp
# Plain http when proxied — the host proxy upgrades it to HTTPS; the
# sha256 pin guarantees integrity either way.
URL='https://pkg.cloudflareclient.com/pool/bookworm/main/c/cloudflare-warp/cloudflare-warp_2026.6.836.0_arm64.deb'
if [ -n "$http_proxy" ]; then URL='http://pkg.cloudflareclient.com/pool/bookworm/main/c/cloudflare-warp/cloudflare-warp_2026.6.836.0_arm64.deb'; fi
wget -q -T 120 "$URL" -O warp.deb
echo '992e1f399e08831a4a45a9bbc18aae95ec68764598b9603b7d3a2d7bfc720b14  warp.deb' | sha256sum -c -
# Extract, don't apt-install: the deb's Depends pull its tray GUI's
# webkit stack, which warp-svc/warp-cli never use — their runtime
# libraries are baked into the base image. --keep-directory-symlink
# writes the deb's top-level bin/ and lib/ through usrmerge symlinks.
dpkg-deb --fsys-tarfile warp.deb | tar -x -C / --keep-directory-symlink
rm -f warp.deb
mkdir -p /var/lib/cloudflare-warp /var/log/cloudflare-warp
systemctl disable warp-svc.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true  # config-agent starts warp-svc on demand
# Extraction skips dpkg's dependency check — fail loudly (grep prints
# the offenders) if a deb bump ever grows a dep the image lacks.
if ldd /bin/warp-svc | grep 'not found'; then exit 1; fi
if ldd /usr/bin/warp-cli | grep 'not found'; then exit 1; fi
timeout 10 env LANG=C LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/warp-cli --version

install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings
KEYURL='https://dl.google.com/linux/linux_signing_key.pub'
if [ -n "$http_proxy" ]; then KEYURL='http://dl.google.com/linux/linux_signing_key.pub'; fi
wget -q -T 60 -O - "$KEYURL" | gpg --dearmor > /etc/apt/keyrings/google-chrome.gpg
echo 'deb [arch=arm64 signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/google-chrome.gpg] https://dl.google.com/linux/chrome/deb/ stable main' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/google-chrome.list
# Update ONLY the Google repo's list: the base image already satisfies
# every Chrome dependency (chromium pulled the same stack), so a full
# apt-get update would pull tens of MB of ports.ubuntu.com lists just
# to fetch one deb from dl.google.com. Fall back to a full update if
# the scoped one can't resolve (e.g. an older base image).
apt-get update -qq -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=sources.list.d/google-chrome.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o APT::Get::List-Cleanup=0 || apt-get update -qq
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends google-chrome-stable || { apt-get update -qq; DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends google-chrome-stable; }
# /etc/opt/chrome is a symlink to /etc/chromium (baked by setup.sh) so
# Chrome sees the same Bromure policies + native-messaging hosts.
test -e /etc/opt/chrome/policies/managed/bromure.json
timeout 10 /usr/bin/google-chrome-stable --version
